Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Mods: All Melee Weapons

For the purest of cyberninjas, carbon fiber blades and speedware can provide abilities once thought to be the stuff of cheesy action films.

Once per Round at the start of the user’s Turn, if they also meet all of the following criteria, they can enter Blocking Stance without an Action to attempt deflecting incoming Attacks with the wielded weapon:

  • Has active Speedware, Berserk, and/or is experiencing the Primary Effect of Timewarp.
  • Not currently suffering any REF, DEX, or MOVE penalty.
  • Not Prone, in a Grapple, or inside of a vehicle.

While in Blocking Stance, the deflecting weapon must be wielded in two hands and cannot make Aimed Shots. Until the start of the user’s next Turn, they suffer a -2 penalty to their REF, DEX, and MOVE, and are considered to have an active Bulletproof Shield (5 HP if the weapon is Poor Quality, 10 HP for Standard, 15 HP for Excellent Quality or if the user has a total Initiative Bonus of +4 or higher).

This shield’s HP resets whenever the user enters Blocking Stance. If this form of Bulletproof Shield is destroyed, the user exits Blocking Stance and the weapon’s quality is reduced by one tier (Excellent to Standard, Standard to Poor, Poor to Non-Functional). Restoring a weapon to its original quality requires 10 minutes and a DV13 Weaponstech Check.

Attachment slots: 0 (Weapon Mod)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Mod Catalog > Weapon Mods).
